headerDisplay: The Assistant: AI features for Homebridge and MP Consulting plugins, plus an MCP server for Claude Desktop, Claude Code and Cursor.
footerDisplay: API keys stay on this Homebridge server and are never sent to the browser-side plugin pages.

model.title: Model
model.description: Leave empty for the provider's default: claude-sonnet-5-5, gpt-5, gemini-2.5-pro, or llama3.1 for a local server.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Required for Claude, OpenAI and Gemini. Optional for a local server.

baseUrl.title: Server URL
baseUrl.description: The OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. Ollama http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 or LM Studio http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1.

contextTokens.title: Context window (tokens)
contextTokens.description: How much text the local model can read at once. Inputs such as logs are trimmed to fit.

maxRetries.title: Retries on provider errors
maxRetries.description: How many times a request is retried when the provider is busy, rate limits it or cannot be reached (with growing waits). 0 turns retrying off.

enabled.title: Serve MCP over HTTP
enabled.description: Lets Claude Desktop, Claude Code and Cursor control Homebridge through this plugin.

host.title: Bind address
host.description: 127.0.0.1 keeps it on this machine. Use 0.0.0.0 only on a trusted network.

token.title: Client token
token.description: MCP clients must send this as a bearer token.

homebridgeToken.title: Homebridge API token
homebridgeToken.description: An API token from Homebridge Glass UI (Settings, API tokens) the MCP tools act with. Use a read-only token to block changes.

homebridgeTokenId.title: Homebridge API token id
homebridgeTokenId.description: Set by Homebridge Glass UI when it creates the API token above, so it can revoke that token when you replace or remove it. Leave it as is.

homebridgeCertFingerprint.title: Trusted certificate fingerprint (SHA-256)
homebridgeCertFingerprint.description: For a Homebridge UI served over HTTPS with a self-signed certificate: the certificate's SHA-256 fingerprint (openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256 -in cert.pem). Only that exact certificate is trusted; any other is refused.

homebridgeCertPath.title: Trusted certificate file (PEM)
homebridgeCertPath.description: Alternatively, a PEM file with the Homebridge UI's own certificate or the CA that issued it. It is trusted in addition to the public certificate authorities.
